member.remarks: Contoh body: { "facts": { "commercial_name": "Excavator", "primary_function": "menggali tanah", "assembled_status": "complete" } }. Response status: DETERMINED (finalCode + tariffs), NEED_CLARIFICATION (questions + candidateCodes; jawab lewat POST /{caseId}/facts), NEED_EXPERT_REVIEW (tanpa kode final, candidateCodes untuk ahli), atau ERROR (message berisi alasan validasi).
